title: France's largest wildfire in decades now 'under control', interior minister says
summary: French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez on Saturday said that France's largest wildfire since 1949 was "under control", more than a week since the fire erupted in the Gironde department near the southwestern city of Bordeaux.
